title: Painting the sides of railroad rails white to reduce derailment
summary: Union Pacific implemented a safety initiative to paint the sides of railroad rails white, which reflects sunlight and reduces heat absorption, thereby preventing rail buckling and heat-related derailments during extreme temperatures.
problem_solved: Rail buckling and derailments caused by thermal expansion of steel rails during hot weather.
why_valuable: A simple, cost-effective engineering solution that significantly improves railroad safety and reduces expensive derailments without requiring complex infrastructure changes.
